verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a dedicated webhooks capability that pushes real-time event notifications to a specified endpoint instead of polling, explicitly positioned as 'the canonical surface for any event-driven workflow' for triggers like large transactions, bill approvals, card issuance, and anomaly conditions — directly matching the AI-native subscribe-to-events story. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on third-party verification of webhook delivery reliability or payload schema beyond first-party docs.
